label: ProductLifecycleCompliance process: Dashboard incident resolution and compliance performance — Report on safety incident resolution times and vendor compliance performance to identify systemic procurement quality trends.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

ENGINEERING CHANGE MANAGEMENT (Primary):
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- Part of: proc_EngChangeAndProcurement_v1, proc_ServiceToProduction_v1, proc_QualityDrivenMfgSupplyChain_v1

MANUFACTURING CHANGE ORCHESTRATION:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process)

BOM COMPLIANCE & MATERIAL VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1

MATERIAL & VENDOR QUALIFICATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1

PROCUREMENT & PURCHASE ORDERS:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (PO creation/approval)
- Enables PO lifecycle management: creation, approval workflows, real-time status tracking
- Exposes: PurchaseOrder, Vendor entities
- Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance
- Part of: proc_ProductComplianceManufacturing_v1

INCIDENT & SAFETY COMPLIANCE MONITORING:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
- Automates vendor safety compliance verification across POs and contracts
- Monitors vendor contract adherence to EHS requirements
- Processes compliance exceptions through escalation workflows
- Automates reconciliation between vendor safety profiles, contract terms, and procurement

INCIDENT RESPONSE & ROOT CAUSE:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
- Analyzes safety incidents, identifies root causes, recommends corrective actions
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
- Coordinates safety incident workflows and automates emergency response

DASHBOARDING / REPORTING:
NO DASHBOARDING OR ANALYTICS RESOURCES FOUND in landscape.
- All agents are operational workflow coordinators, not analytics engines
- No BI/reporting/dashboard resources identified across sap.ehs, sap.s4, corp.itsm, sap.sf
- Activity requires dashboard + KPI reporting + trend analysis = NOT IN LANDSCAPE

args.reason: Best available resource for tracking vendor compliance performance and automating compliance monitoring workflows that feed incident resolution and procurement quality assessment, though it lacks native dashboarding capabilities.
